answer.summary: Spring test context fails to start in 348 of 675 API tests because of a circular bean reference (workflowService -> ... -> exerciseService -> workflowService). This is a deterministic wiring failure, not a timing flake, so a rerun should repeat it. The only file the change touches is WorkflowServiceTest.java, so the log doesn't prove the PR caused it. Check whether that test's fixtures or wiring added a dependency cycle. The 'persisted 1x before' history also suggests it may predate this change.

evidence.quote: Caused by: org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanCurrentlyInCreationException: Error creating bean with name 'workflowService': Requested bean is currently in creation: Is there an unresolvable circular reference or an asynchronous initialization dependency?
[ERROR] Tests run: 3, Failures: 0, Errors: 3, Skipped: 0, Time elapsed: 36.68 s <<< FAILURE! -- in the platform-write marker is scoped to the method that sets it

Relying upon circular references is discouraged and they are prohibited by default. Update your application to remove the dependency cycle between beans. As a last resort, it may be possible to break the cycle automatically by setting spring.main.allow-circular-references to true.
